sourceTitle: A Letter on the Abolition of the Slave Trade Addressed to the freeholders and other inhabitants of Yorkshire
description: "A Letter on the Abolition of the Slave Trade" by William Wilberforce is a historical account written in the early 19th century. The work serves as a passionate appeal to the freeholders and inhabitants of Yorkshire, urging them to acknowledge the moral imperative to abolish the slave trade.
